newsitem.title: USA: U.S. midweek cash lumber review - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: U.S. midweek cash lumber review - Jan 22.

text.p: Random Lengths Gross List Cash Lumber Prices Quotes:

Comment - Lumber trading was mixed through Tuesday, Random Lengths said in its midweek review. Wholesalers covering orders they had accumulated sparked some S-P-F sales Monday. Meanwhile, the recently hot Southern Pine market started at a more measured pace and trading in other species was muted, the agency said.

The OSB and Southern Pine plywood markets softened while western plywood stayed firm. After affecting much of the U.S. last week, winter weather moderated. But dealers showed little inclination to build up low inventories, Random Lengths said.

Western S-P-F prices firmed based largely on a flurry of action in Std&Btr 2x4 Friday that carried over for some mills on Monday. Most traders reported a slowdown on Tuesday. Some buyers turned to eastern Canada for more flexible prices and tallies. Reports of delayed rail shipments due to bad weather persisted.
Canadian exports as of Jan 14 were running at 7.9 percent of Jan-March quota and 82.7 percent of annual April/March quota.

Eastern S-P-F mills held quotes but occasionally opened to counters, particularly on #1&2 2x6. Lower prices had little effect on buyers, most of whom booked only necessities. A spark of buying Tuesday put the brakes on further erosion of #1&2 2x4 and 2x4 precut studs, the lumber reporting agency said.
Southern Pine sales were off from last week's active pace, but producers sold what they needed to and prices continued to rise. The #2 2x8&wdr tightened in part to low supply of logs.
Inland mills' sales of dimension were spotty, leaving prices flat to soft. In Hem-Fir, Std&Btr 2x4 slipped a notch while #2&Btr 2x10 was discounted $5-10. Demand for studs was muted.

Coast Hem-Fir and dry Douglas fir failed to establish a clear trend. Activity was uneven from mill to mill but customers tended to buy hand-to-mouth. Prices were mixed with the wides stronger than the narrows in both species, Randpom Lengths said. (Chicago newsdesk 312 408 8720)
